recording_instructions.unit: One shopper-turn recording per user slot; assistant turns are fixed text.
recording_instructions.order: Record all turns of a scenario in one language, then create its other language versions with the same intent.
recording_instructions.state: Displayed state is the trusted state at the final decision point, not a live cart changed by recordings.
recording_instructions.transcription: Compare STT text against your recording; correct recognition errors without removing spoken repetitions, repairs or discourse markers.
recording_instructions.revision: If the recording deviates from the brief, flag it and re-record or explicitly resolve the intended meaning. No AI rewriting.
recording_instructions.language: Use natural varieties, not caricatures. Shared product names, amounts and loanwords are acceptable; labels are intended conditions, not claims of linguistic purity.
